page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor based on the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs, providing a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the instance generally falls into the lower performance tiers. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the instance in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Memory read bandwidth is also positioned in the bottom 25%, though large block write memory bandwidth reaches average levels. Cryptographic and database operations, including Redis SET benchmarks, perform in the bottom 25%. For specialized workloads, LLM inference with a small 135M model achieves average speeds, whereas performance drops to the bottom 10% for a medium 7B model.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.se1ne.2xlarge offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio suitable for memory-bound workloads that do not require high-performance compute or local storage. The primary tradeoff is the lower-tier CPU and memory read performance relative to the allocated resources. This profile makes the instance appropriate for memory-intensive but compute-light workloads, such as caching layers, small database hosting, and basic memory-resident applications.
